title: Serialized Control Interface ASIC for Distributed Controllers of Space-Borne RADAR
problem: SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) payloads require distributed control hierarchy with bulky interconnect lines between central and distributed controllers, increasing complexity, size, weight, and harness complexity.
motivation: New space arena demands miniaturized, low-weight SAR payloads with reduced subsystems and interconnection infrastructure. Current TRC subsystems are separate large units with significant interconnect overhead.
method: Integrated SCI ASIC (Serialized Control Interface) housed inside TR Module as a single IC component, replacing separate TRC subsystem. Uses pattern generator concept to generate signals internally, eliminating need for separate differential inter-connect lines for telecommand, telemetry, and radar timing.
key_novelty: Integration of TRC functionality into single IC (SCI ASIC), elimination of bulky interconnect harness through on-chip signal generation via pattern generator.
contributions: Novel SCI ASIC architecture for distributed radar controller integration
Significant reduction in harness complexity and interconnect lines
Miniaturization of SAR payload by eliminating separate TRC subsystem
Pattern generator-based signal generation to replace external interconnects
baselines: Separate TRC subsystem with differential interconnects
limitations: Abstract only; no quantitative metrics provided; specific power/area savings not mentioned.
